subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — Retail Bank
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@retailbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — Retail Bank

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our demo and a proposed outline for the 4‑week POC so we can align on success criteria, responsibilities, and timeline. Attached is a short POC proposal and a draft SOW for your procurement team.

High‑level recap of today's demo:
- Showed Redwood API latency/cost profile for embeddings and chat generation at 99th percentile.
- Walked through private deployment options and key security controls (VPC peering, KMS integration).
- Live example: customer support reranking + summarization pipeline using your sample transcripts.

Proposed POC (4 weeks) — goals and scope:
1) Success criteria (must have):
   - Summarization latency: avg < 250ms per request for 1k concurrent users.
   - Relevance uplift: 10%+ improvement in rerank NDCG on your held‑out set.
   - Cost target: reduce per‑session token cost by 20% vs current baseline using batching + caching.
2) Evaluation plan:
   - Week 0: Kickoff + environment provisioning (we'll provide a temporary dedicated cluster or private evaluation instance).
   - Week 1: Ingest sample data, baseline metrics collection (you run baseline and share logs).
   - Week 2‑3: Model config iterations (quantization and batching experiments) + monitoring dashboards.
   - Week 4: Final evaluation, handoff materials, and exec recap.
3) Ownership:
   - Retail Bank: provide sample data, baseline metrics, and a primary technical contact (we request a senior engineer + product owner).
   - Redwood: environment provisioning, SRE support during runbook, model config experiments, and measurement report.
4) Timeline:
   - Proposed start: Mon 31 Aug 2026 (can shift to the following week if needed).
   - Finish: Fri 25 Sep 2026 (4 weeks).
5) Next steps / ask from you:
   - Confirm success criteria above or propose edits.
   - Confirm primary technical contact for Retail Bank.
   - Approve proposed start or share alternate start date.

Attachments: POC‑Proposal‑RetailBank.pdf (summary + milestones), Draft‑SOW‑RetailBank.docx (procurement friendly).

Links: HubSpot deal and shared Drive folder with sample notebooks and runbook are included below.

If this all looks good I can schedule the kickoff and loop in our SRE/solutions engineering to provision a short‑lived evaluation environment.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555‑0192

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Sophie Miller <sophie.miller@retailbank.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — Retail Bank

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and draft plan. Appreciate the concise success criteria. A few notes from our side after sync with Sophie (product owner):

- Success criteria: the latency target you suggested looks reasonable; can we validate at 2k concurrent users instead of 1k? Our traffic is spiky and we need headroom.
- Relevance uplift: we'll confirm the NDCG target internally but 10% is a good starting point.
- Cost target: we like the idea of batching + caching; please include an estimate range for per‑session token cost after quantization experiments.

Timeline: the proposed start week of Aug 31 is tight for procurement. Can we aim for week of Sep 7 start? That gives Sophie time to get the SOW reviewed.

Technical ask: we'd like a 30‑minute deep technical session with Neha next week to go over data ingestion and the runbook (S3 access, anonymization, and logging/metrics). Can Neha propose 2 slots?

Finally, one small ask for the SOW: please include a clause about data handling and retention during the POC (we'll give procurement suggested wording).

If you can update the timeline and add a quick cost estimate in the POC doc, we'll be ready to move.

Thanks,
Alex
Director, Product — Retail Bank
alex.johnson@retailbank.com | +1 (212) 555‑0147

Alex —

Great, thanks for the feedback. Short answers and next steps: 

- Concurrency validation: yes — we'll run a 2k concurrent stress test during Week 1 baseline (I'll note that as a Must Have).
- Cost estimate: attached a one‑pager with a conservative per‑session token cost range after quantization/batching experiments — will add to the main POC doc and share an updated PDF.
- Timeline: we can shift start to Mon 7 Sep 2026 to accommodate procurement.
- SOW/data handling: we'll add a POC data retention clause (data will be deleted 30 days after POC unless otherwise agreed) and mark any logged data as retention‑limited for the evaluation. Procurement language to review welcome.
- Technical session: Neha — can you propose two 30‑minute slots next week for Alex & Sophie? Prefer Tue 9 Sep 09:00‑09:30 PT or Wed 10 Sep 14:00‑14:30 PT.

I'll circulate an updated POC‑Proposal PDF and Draft‑SOW with the timeline change and cost estimate by EOD Monday. If that works, I'll schedule kickoff for 7 Sep and book the technical session once Neha confirms availability.

Thanks!
Marissa
